notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Two pages say the tower is gone (the Association list and the Forest Lookouts Virginia entry, which gives only the year 1993). No build year, design, owner or staffing appears in any source read, so the story leaves those out and falls short of the usual 120-word floor. The Wikipedia page is about the community, not the lookout. Its coordinates differ slightly from the Association point (38.25090, -78.41045), and this is not resolved. Next check: Greene County historical records or a newspaper for the tower's build and removal.
